project_name.justification: The text announces the sale of claims within the Forrest Kerr Project: "Aben and GCMC have completed the transaction as per the Purchase and Sale Agreement (the 'Agreement') for the sale of six minerals claims from its Forrest Kerr Project portfolio..."

company_name.justification: The press release is issued by and is about Aben Minerals Ltd. This contradicts the authoritative metadata 'Aben Gold Corp.', but is a direct name from the source document: 'Aben Minerals Ltd. (TSX-V: ABM) (“Aben” or “the Company”) is pleased to announce the Company has completed the sale of 6 claims...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The buyer is identified as Galore Creek Mining Corporation ('GCMC'). The text does not name the CEO of GCMC. The CEO mentioned, Riley Trimble, is the President & CEO of the seller, Aben Minerals Ltd.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The buyer, GCMC, acquired a 100% interest in the specified claims. 'Under the terms of the Agreement, GCMC has agreed to purchase a 100% interest in six mineral claims...'

primary_commodity.justification: The text describes the seller, Aben Minerals, as a gold exploration company and mentions a gold discovery zone on the retained property. 'Aben Minerals is a Canadian gold exploration company...' and 'The gold discovery zone known as the North Boundary Zone...'

verified_article_link.justification: The provided text is a press release and does not contain a URL to an online article version.

currency.justification: The cash consideration is explicitly stated in Canadian dollars: '...in exchange for $200,000 CAD.'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction was completed for a single cash payment. 'Under the terms of the Agreement, GCMC has agreed to purchase a 100% interest in six mineral claims... in exchange for $200,000 CAD.'

share_payments_raw.justification: The consideration was entirely in cash, with no mention of share payments.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The consideration was explicitly defined as a cash payment, so this combined field is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The consideration was entirely in cash, with no shares being issued as part of the transaction.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: The consideration was entirely in cash, so there is no issued share price for the transaction.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The agreement terms do not mention any exploration commitment in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement terms do not mention any monetary exploration spending commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: No Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) was acquired or retained as part of the transaction terms.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The claims sold have a total specified area: '...six mineral claims totalling approximately 3,200 hectares...'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is explicitly stated: '...six mineral claims totalling approximately 3,200 hectares...'

resource_size.justification: The text does not provide a quantified mineral resource estimate for the six claims being sold. It mentions a 'gold discovery zone' that remains with Aben, but provides no JORC or NI 43-101 compliant resource estimate for any part of the property.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified as Galore Creek Mining Corporation ('GCMC'), but no stock ticker or exchange is provided for this entity in the text. The tickers mentioned (TSX-V: ABM) belong to the seller, Aben Minerals Ltd.
